title: First Completely Painted Row or Column
summary: Given an integer array arr and an m x n matrix mat, both containing integers from 1 to m * n, paint cells in mat according to arr.
statement: Given an integer array arr and an m x n matrix mat, both containing integers from 1 to m * n, paint cells in mat according to arr. Return the earliest index i where either a row or a column is fully painted.
constraints: arr and mat each contain every integer one through rows*columns exactly once.
Paint the cell containing arr[i] at step i.
Return the earliest zero-based step that completes any full row or full column.
hints: Map every matrix value to its row and column.
Maintain painted counts for every row and column.
For each value in arr, increment its two counts and return as soon as either reaches its full length.
Unique values mean each step paints one new cell, so a count reaches its dimension exactly at the first completion of that line.
editorial: Unique values mean each step paints one new cell, so a count reaches its dimension exactly at the first completion of that line.

tests.explanation: After steps zero through two, the right column containing four and three is complete, so return two.
The middle column is completed when four is painted at step three.
